facts.fact: UNESCO IITE reports that a mission of 11-15 February 2019 assessed needs and set out to design a school integrated management information system that is to track each student's progress, including classroom assessment; the EMIS was still to be developed, over 12 months after a 3-month technical document, and no school is stated as using it.
facts.system: EMIS / school integrated management information system (SIMIS)

facts.fact: UNESCO IITE reports that the EMIS is the Ministry of Education's to establish, coordinated by its Director of E-Education with UNESCO technical support, and that the needs assessment and design reports were to support including its resource needs in the 2019/2020 budget.
facts.system: EMIS / school integrated management information system (SIMIS)

systems.system: EMIS / school integrated management information system (SIMIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Human Resources, Tertiary Education and Scientific Research, with UNESCO IITE and UNESCO HQ support
systems.tiers: planned for national, zone and school levels; pre-primary to tertiary
